in_marathi.name: Dhrumit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fearless, Ruler of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrumit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhrumit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhruma’ which means ‘moving,’ ‘vibrating,’ or ‘ruler.’ In Hindu mythology, Dhrumit is considered a fearless and powerful name, evoking the strength and stability of the earth.
